summary: Replace mission-renderer diagnostic lighting inputs with the selected scene's reconstructed Lights reader and retain its foliage settings with the existing foliage owner.

findings.change: lum_scale_offset now uses x87_mul24 then x87_add24; degrees_to_radians uses x87_mul24 then x87_div24, preserving the original CE3D28/CE3D20 double constants and the wider intermediate exponent range.
findings.evidence: bsp.py show 004EA870 --asm: FMUL/FADD at 004EAB45/004EAB49 and qword FMUL/FDIV at 004EB0E0/004EB0E8. One regression fixture checks 35 degrees == 3f1c61ab and luminance cancellation == +0 after separate rounding.

findings.change: Missing/invalid g_Environment.Lights headers throw before native light creation/binding. create_and_bind and configure_scene_owners require a completely read authored header. The fabricated-default fallback was removed and 004B6800 is skipped.
findings.evidence: bsp.py show 004B6800 --asm confirms untouched cube +20..+7F and specular-scale +B8; this owner has no recovered prior words for those fields. The rebuilt game no longer links/calls reset_lighting_configuration_004b6800.

counts.note: 004EA870 has called=true and one real body call, while the text heuristic labels it callees_done_no_wired_caller. Four real bodies plus the normal-setter Host override give five new address matches versus the pre-chain build; the Host override is not a standalone native body. Review removed the unsupported 004B6800 fallback.

state_contract: The root properties come from the existing GameNativeMissionUnitSource for the selected simulation scene.
The linearize flag is the existing captured native settings +8C byte; the reader supplies scene colors, alpha/luminance words, scales and angles without replacement constants.
004BACD0 writes the same current native ambient and directional owners already used by the installed ship shader.
Only a completely read authored Lights sub-bag may bind those owners. Missing/invalid lighting headers are rejected because native untouched default words have no recovered prior state here.

The foliage owner retains semantic +78 and texture-name companions; its genuine base receives the authored normal byte. Its admitted bush group list is empty because this renderer graph admits no landscape/bush geometry.

checks.call_graph: python tools/call_graph.py; who checks prove body calls for 004EA870, 00AD7140, 00AD7FE0 and 004E5C00; path 004EA870 reaches WinMainCRTStartup through the mission renderer. 004B6800 is no longer linked in the game.
checks.rounding_regression: One reconstructed_math Lights fixture checks both angle fields at 35 degrees against 3f1c61ab and checks Ambient/cube alpha cancellation against +0; both fail with the former retained-double expressions.
checks.installed_scene_probe: Ignored local Win32 probe linked with /MANIFEST:EMBED; the installed USN/usn_2_java.scn passed the existing Lights reader with PC24 and HDR linearization. Ambient=(0.353704,0.436848,0.320407,1), diffuse_scale=5, specular_scale=30, angles=(2.26893,0.610865), bush_diffuse=0.4, bush_normal=1, bush_texture=foliageatlas.dds.

limitations: No game was launched; build, reachability and installed-data fixture evidence do not prove gameplay appearance or Original ABI compatibility.
The existing bounded renderer still lacks the original post20 exposure/display composition, so replacing diagnostic illumination with authored inputs can change visible brightness.

Headers without a valid, completely read g_Environment.Lights sub-bag are unsupported and rejected before light owner binding; the native missing-Lights constructor arm needs recovered prior cube/specular-scale words.

Full sky/cloud scattering, skybox/effect application, terrain/material setup, music/environment audio and derived foliage geometry remain outside this change. Retained bush texture names are pending settings, not evidence of loaded bush textures.
